name: Truth's Blade

automation.text: You punish one who would speak falsely to you. The creature must make a Wisdom saving throw. If it fails, for the duration, it takes 4d8 Psychic damage whenever it lies.

components.material: A silver pin, which is not consumed

description: You punish one who would speak falsely to you. The creature must make a Wisdom saving throw. If it fails, for the duration, it takes 4d8 Psychic damage whenever it lies.
higherlevels: The amount of Psychic damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 3rd.
